model_provenance.implementation: dataset_annotation.annotate_dataset.propose; no individual overrides or recorded labels
model_provenance.limitation: Rules were developed using the corpus including test; improved labels were largely produced by the same rules. This measures agreement, not independent generalization.

protocol.overlap_scope: scenario reference train; published model trained on improved_dataset

model_provenance.selection: published weights and thresholds unchanged; no training or test tuning

metadata.provenance: genuine recorded API probabilities; exact input/source replay, not fresh calls; labels not reused

tokenization.normalization: NFKC; collapse whitespace; preserve case and ё
tokenization.pooling: mean over all attention-masked tokens of real windows, including special tokens
tokenization.padding: longest real window in document batch

training.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss; unweighted mean over documents and classes

model_provenance.task_training: none; upstream pretrained weights, fixed prompt and threshold
model_provenance.upstream_training_overlap: unknown; upstream training data not available for audit

limitations: Source mcId is absent in test and assumed to be 101.
All rows are scored; no duplicates or overlapping examples are removed.
Regex rules were designed using test; improved labels are not independent of regex.
TF-IDF uses fixed original-train weights; learned_keywords uses fixed improved-train weights.
Historical results retained for unrequested methods are not fresh measurements.
table_policy: One result per module; rerun replaces its row and preserves other compatible rows.
